none: PAS NLM-F171DD: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VAL[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVR]ITAS [REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 2.25gms, die axis: 12
